ai_summary: ANLON HEALTHCARE LIMITED has announced a Board Meeting on October 29, 2026, primarily to consider and approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This routine regulatory filing signals the imminent release of the company's Q2 FY2027 performance data, including an auditor's limited review, which will be a key driver for investor sentiment and valuation. No immediate red flags are present within this intimation, as it is a standard corporate governance disclosure.
